facts.value: Invisible Melee's void(void) initialization hook unconditionally passes the persistent gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_invisible record to gm_InitVsMode. It is separate from the load hook that resets shared KO counts and the battle callback that enables player invisibility.
facts.rationale: Fills the empty initialization-hook subject using its complete canonical definition without inferring the shared initializer's detailed defaults.

facts.value: Forwards the departing GameModeState to gmVsMelee_ExitSuddenDeath, which obtains its MatchExitInfo and calls gm_80166CCC with &gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo.match_end first and the Sudden Death exit match_end second. The helper conditionally reconciles the Sudden Death outcome and player/team standings into the retained ordinary match result; it also adjusts the second record's standings when ties remain. This is not a whole-record copy in either direction. Results entry later copies the retained ordinary match_end into ResultsMatchInfo.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's reversed source/destination interpretation and preserves the helper's bidirectional conditional mutations and cross-scene lifetime.

evidence.why: Argument order and subsequent Results consumer.
Actual conditional mutations of both records.

facts.value: Passes the departing state, persistent modes.vs_invisible record and CSS fallback to gmVsMelee_ExitResults. The finalizer consumes gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo.match_end, skips gm_80168638 and gm_80168710 when the match is canceled, and invokes KO-count updating regardless. Human participation and a nonterminating following descriptor gate progression checks. Challenger selection can schedule Approach; if no challenger route was selected, gm_801721EC can schedule Prize. Exceptional routes perform archive setup and return; otherwise archive setup precedes the CSS fallback write.
facts.rationale: Includes the complete finalizer rather than truncating its account before the Prize and fallback tail.

evidence.why: Accounting guards, progression branches, archive setup and fallback.

facts.value: Implements Invisible Melee's post-results handoff through the shared Versus finalizer: ordinary flow returns to character selection, while guarded progression can redirect to Approach or, when no challenger route was selected and the shared prize predicate succeeds, Prize.
facts.rationale: Preserves the omitted Prize route without guessing the detailed unlock conditions of opaque progression helpers.

evidence.why: Both exceptional destinations and normal fallback.

facts.value: Runs on exit from the Results descriptor and supplies CSS as the default next-state ID. In the shared finalizer, human participation and state[1].id != GM_GAMEMODESTATE_TERMINATE enable progression checks. Three ordered challenger checks can schedule Approach. After further shared processing, !unk_bool && gm_801721EC() schedules Prize. A selected exceptional route calls lbCardGame_SetupArchive and returns without overwriting its destination; otherwise the finalizer calls the same archive setup and writes the caller's CSS fallback.
facts.rationale: Makes the route-selection gates, precedence and early-return behavior explicit.

facts.value: Implements ordinary Invisible Melee's post-battle routing through gmVsMelee_ExitVs. The shared multiple-winners predicate selects Sudden Death only when the outcome is not OUTCOME_NO_CONTEST and the relevant winner count exceeds one: team winners when is_teams == 1, otherwise player winners. A false predicate selects Results. Participation filtering for the subsequent Sudden Death battle belongs to shared setup, not this wrapper.
facts.rationale: Replaces the broad tie/participation statement with source-exact routing, including no-contest and team exceptions.

evidence.why: Results and Sudden Death destination order.
